answer: Every identity must answer 12 unpredictable 256-MiB retrieval challenges from 6 independent auditors each epoch. A tide beacon schedules the windows and groups shared routes into one vine cluster. Member k must serve 256*k^2 MiB per challenge, so the next fake adds 256*(2*k-1) MiB. The canyon log verifies signed timing receipts; two misses erase rewards and ban the cluster keys for 8 epochs.
